note: Traffic officer (yellow vest, baton) standing on the lane line directly ahead; we pull off at 6-16 km/h and pass him on our right at about 1-2 m. From 21.0 s he is close in front (box ~55 px tall and growing, centred in our path) until he is beside our right front corner at ~22.8 s. Before 21 s he is 30-40 px tall and far away (not close). Not a hazard he caused (he is directing traffic) but it is exactly the geometric definition of the type.

Collision in our forward path: a motorcycle (25-50 px) enters from the left at ~23.4 s, crosses ahead of us and strikes the left side of the car ahead at ~23.75 s; the video ends at 23.79 s. Judgement call: the taxonomy has no type for a crash between two other road users; forward_collision_risk is the closest. Strictly, our own time-to-contact is not under 3 s (the car ahead was pulling away until ~23.3 s).
